evidenceLines: The Master of Landscape Architecture program inspires you to produce research informed designs that celebrate equitable, adaptive, resilient and sustainable urban and regional environments. The program engages with the Sydney region as its landscape laboratory. You will be encouraged to engage with global issues and your international experiences at the local scale. The core of the program is the design studio sequence, with each studio supported by a skill and/or knowledge-based course. Your design process will be informed by research and critical analysis of landscape sites and systems, and your design outcomes will be shaped by modelling, testing and dialogue. Elective courses provide opportunities for you to pursue interdisciplinary, specialised interests across the faculty, particularly in the areas Urban Design and City Analytics. The final-year capstone studio sequence provides you with the opportunity to undertake an independent research-based design project.
